breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the flow would be turbulent at the specified conditions. It replaced the user's incorrect laminar boundary-layer correlation with a correct turbulent correlation (δ ≈ 0.37 * x * Re_x^(-1/5)), which is the same correction made in the ground truth.
